mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (id, user_id, role_id, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0
